title: Bluegill Triple Prime 1962 UFO recovery
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bluegill Triple Prime 1962 UFO recovery, about October 1962 at Pacific, Johnston Island area, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He talked about actually holding the pieces from this crash and that uh it came down I guess out of the plume of this nuclear blast in 1962 in October.
